assertions.description: A wrong app fails at least two of its declared probes.
Failed probes are published with their error code rather than dropped from the stream.
The probe stream has the same shape for the wrong and the right app: a probe that only exists when it fails cannot be trusted.
The identical probes pass against the correct app.
The wrong app is still served with HTTP 200: the failure is a content failure, not a sandbox refusal.
